goal: Reduce simultaneous retention of ignored client display-character maps during full-payload Arena validation without changing HTTP evidence size, JSON parsing, validation or canonical output.
sourceFacts: SessionValidator only assigns candidate.characters from independent replay; it does not inspect the supplied characters field.
Both checkpoint and default full/final validation overwrite that field before JSON serializability/hash derivation.
public/index.php currently retains the decoded original body while canonical candidate replay and database locking proceed.
The current full-capacity producer sends thousands of character-slot arrays per candidate; body decoding must continue to validate all bytes before any cleanup.

proposedBoundary.route: Only the already identified POST arena submit operation, after complete existing RequestBody.decode succeeds
proposedBoundary.operation: If body.candidate is an array and has an existing characters key, replace its value in place with null. Do not unset/reinsert the key and do not add a missing key, preserving insertion order of the canonical candidate.
unchanged: All locks, durability, rate and authentication policies
notProposed: A custom or regex JSON-skipping parser
Changing any production file during source35 adoption

requiredPureEvidenceBeforeAdoption.wholeCorpus: All578 executed rows, including all560 unique existing candidates; compare exact canonical candidate key order, full bundle, replay/chart, payloadHash and rejection type/code/message to frozen baseline.
requiredPureEvidenceBeforeAdoption.HTTPReachableOverflow: Retain all existing raw JSON overflow outcomes. Nonfinite values inside overwritten characters remain accepted where baseline accepts; nonfinite retained extras continue rejecting. JSON parse errors are still raised before cleanup.
shapes: wrong scalar/object/list shapes already ignored by baseline
requiredPureEvidenceBeforeAdoption.memoryAndCpu: A separately approved twelve alternating-pair diagnostic with all raw samples, no warmup/filter/retry, measuring decode+cleanup+validation and live memory while preserving a caller-owned body. Fresh-process peak measurements must distinguish peak decode allocation from later retained memory.
requiredPureEvidenceBeforeAdoption.runtime: Only if pure evidence and measured benefit justify adoption: new source freeze, actual native final/retry, and original fresh ordinary full1653+wire1653 with20concurrent/50x8/strict p95 below150ms.
